verdict.rationale: SumUp's own POS tier claims multi-store management from a single back-office login and multi-device sync. Its Cloud API documents pairing and naming multiple Solo readers per account. 'Powerful reporting' is mentioned only generically, with nothing showing reports, devices, or settings scoped to each location. missing for 10: documentation of per-location device assignment, per-location settings, per-location reporting breakdowns, and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a pricing-page bullet.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can run multiple locations with per-location devices, settings, and reporting

citations.quote: Manage multiple stores from one back office login
Multi-device sync, and connect several ticket printers
Payment links, powerful reporting, invoicing, and more
Pairing multiple Solo card readers with any SumUp account
